Over the Z-BEACH and Z-APPR zones, with the crew on the beach (N-15), so the ground hazard is high. This is a hazard, not a critical-asset indicator.
S-RF telemetry altitude (57 to 190 m, 82 m at 10:16:20) is far from radar (148 to 161 m) and gimbal (135 to 163 m). It is unexplained, so the telemetry may be false (system prompt note).
indicators_down: Pilot located by S-RF at about (-1312,-230), error 80 m, stable over four of five fixes, so the pilot is not obviously hiding (ROE-3.3). The 10:16:00 fix (-1308,-325) is a 95 m outlier, within the error.
Drone is about 1150 m from the nearest critical asset (Z-HOUSE) and not heading toward it. It is staying near the shore (ROE-3.3).
Gimbal sees a quadcopter with blade spin and no payload (S-GIM 10:16:20). Group 1, small radar class.
Alert level NORMAL (N-01).
input.recommended_action: Keep rungs 0 and 1: keep tracking and keep the gimbal on T-1. Propose rung 2 for operator approval. Ask the control room to confirm whether the pilot fix (-1312,-230), 80 m error, is on base. The zone tool lists only Z-APPR at that point and no off-base zone, but it does not say on or off base. If on base, send security to detain and question the pilot and have the drone landed (ROE-6.1). Tell security the fix is about 170 m from the crew area (N-15) and inside Z-APPR, which is active only when the tower reports traffic (N-12). Ask the tower for status. If the pilot is off base on U.S. land, notify Harborview Police and do not pursue (ROE-6.2, N-17). If the position cannot be settled, notify security and the control room and watch the drone's path for the pilot (ROE-6.5). No defeat option is needed now. Re-assess every 20 s. Watch for a turn toward Z-HOUSE or another critical asset, a payload, more RF altitude mismatch, link loss, and any aircraft report.

options.reasons: The link is live (S-RF 10:16:20, Hobby-A), so the jammer is technically possible and the threat level meets the MEDIUM minimum (ROE-4.1, ROE-5.1). It is not needed because rung 2 has not been tried (ROE-1.5). Aircraft status is unknown (N-12, ROE-5.2), and the lost-link behaviour is unknown over the occupied beach (ROE-5.3, N-15). If rung 2 fails, re-check these first and pair it with security at the pilot.

Threat is MEDIUM, below the HIGH minimum for rung 4 (ROE-4.1). Rung 2 has not been tried (ROE-1.5). Aircraft traffic in Z-APPR is not known (ROE-5.4, N-12). Wind 5.8 m/s is within the limit (ROE-5.6). The drone is over the beach where the crew works, so debris is a hazard (N-15).

Threat is MEDIUM, below the HIGH minimum for rung 5 (ROE-4.1). Line-of-fire check at 10:16:20 fails: the line beyond the target crosses Z-BEACH and Z-APPR, both with backstop Never (ROE-5.11). The beach is occupied by the N-15 crew and is not confirmed empty. Z-APPR is never allowed when aircraft are active (N-12). PVID exists, but that does not remove the other blocks (ROE-4.7). Rung 2 has not been tried (ROE-1.5).

Threat is not CRITICAL (ROE-4.1, ROE-5.14). The jammer, interceptor and laser are not all blocked or unavailable (ROE-5.14). Line-of-fire check: bearing 272 degrees is outside the 300-060 sector, elevation 4.0 degrees is below the 5-30 degree band, the backstop crosses Z-BEACH, Z-APPR and off-base land (all Never), and the line crosses N-15 (ROE-5.12, ROE-5.13).

notifications.why: Confirm whether the pilot fix is on or off base and whether Z-APPR is active. Needed to choose between ROE-6.1, ROE-6.2 and ROE-6.5.

If the pilot is on base, detain and question the pilot and have the drone landed (ROE-6.1). Warn them the fix is about 170 m from the N-15 crew area. If the position is unsettled, security is notified under ROE-6.5.
Only if the control room confirms the pilot is off base on U.S. land (ROE-6.2). Base security does not pursue off base.
Ask whether Z-APPR is active (N-12). This sets whether any later defeat option is possible (ROE-5.9).

input.what_would_change: Raise to HIGH, and consider rung 3 with the control room if the rung 2 response fails, if any of these happen: the drone turns toward Z-HOUSE or another critical asset, a payload is seen, it loiters over the crew, or it shows hostile behaviour. Any crewed aircraft report in Z-APPR would block jammer and interceptor. Lower to LOW if Remote ID appears or security finds the pilot cooperating. Confirming the pilot is off base would shift the response to ROE-6.2. If the RF altitude mismatch grows or the RF position moves more than 200 m from the others, treat it as possible spoofing and lower track confidence (ROE-2.5). If the tower confirms no aircraft and the beach is confirmed empty, the laser geometry would still need a re-check, because Z-APPR and Z-BEACH are on the line.

input.own_assessment: One drone, T-1, tracked by RF, radar, gimbal and WAC. The gimbal shows a Group 1 quadcopter with blade spin and no payload. It flies repeated passes along the shore at about x -1600 to -1940, y -150 to +180, at 135 to 165 m by radar and gimbal. It is about 1150 m from the nearest critical asset (Z-HOUSE) and not heading toward it. No Remote ID. The control link is live (Hobby-A). The pilot is fixed by RF at about (-1312,-230), error 80 m, and is steady. Indicators: no Remote ID and repeated passes. That makes two, so the threat is MEDIUM (ROE-3.1, ROE-3.2). Lowering factors: pilot in plain view, and flight away from critical assets (ROE-3.3). All equipment is operational. Alert level is NORMAL. A crew of four is on the beach at x -1200 to -1000, y -100 to 0 (N-15, until 12:00). Z-APPR is active only when the tower reports traffic (N-12), and that status is unknown. Rung 2 (security to the pilot, notifications) is allowed at LOW or above and is the lowest rung likely to work. D-LAS is blocked: the threat is below HIGH, and the backstop crosses Z-BEACH and Z-APPR, both "Never". D-GUN is blocked: the threat is not CRITICAL, and the bearing, elevation band, backstop and N-15 checks all fail. D-INT is blocked: the threat is below HIGH. D-JAM meets the MEDIUM minimum and the link is live. It is not justified now, because rung 2 has not been tried and aircraft status and lost-link behaviour over the occupied beach are unknown (ROE-1.5, ROE-5.2, ROE-5.3).
